title: The body-weight moves switch says 'moves with no weight', but it also covers moves done with added weight or assistance
what: Under Previous values, the switch 'Always use all workouts for body-weight moves' says it is for push-ups, pull-ups and other moves with no weight. The app also treats moves logged as body weight plus added weight (a weighted pull-up with a 20 kg belt) and assisted moves as body-weight moves, so those also take last time's numbers from any workout, even with Same routine picked.
expected: The line names every kind of move the switch covers, for example: moves done with your body weight, with or without added weight or help.
who: members who log weighted or assisted body-weight moves and pick Same routine
how_often: every workout with such a move
fix_line: Widen the line under the switch to include added weight and assisted moves.
